_note: Label page (zwrld.org/label/). Change 'name' here to rename the label everywhere on the page (e.g. add 'Inc' once incorporated). Submissions go to the form endpoint below and are emailed to zwrld@zwrld.org.
name: ZWrld Music
about: ZWrld Music is an independent record label founded by the artist ZWrld in Colorado. We release country, hip-hop and faith-inspired music from artists with something real to say, and we help them get it heard.
submit_intro: Got a song you believe in? Send us a link. We listen to every submission and reach out if it's a fit for the label.
submit_steps: Send a link to your track (SoundCloud, YouTube, Google Drive or Dropbox). No file uploads.
Only send music you wrote and recorded, or have the rights to.
We listen to everything. If it's a fit, we'll email you about next steps.
